content: Multi-currency net-worth history is corrupted when apps apply today's FX rate to past balances (rolling conversion). Correct pattern: store balances in native currency; convert for display using the rate effective as-of the chart/query date (time-stamped / LOCF). Rewriting history with current rates creates phantom gains/losses from FX noise alone. Sources: PortfolioPilot, TrackWorth, MyMoneyViz, Freenance.
